page.layout: One printed page, one column of text. Above the text: a decorative woodcut border (not transcribed). Then the dedication heading block, centred. Then the body text, with a woodcut initial I at the left beside the first lines. At the foot: a gathering signature "* 2" at centre-left. No running head and no page number.

page.notes: The woodcut initial is an ornamental I, joined to "brorum" as printed. The top border and the decorative ornament are not text and are left out. Doubtful: "petrahatur" is read as printed, with a comma after it in the scan. The printer uses "quàm" with a grave accent, kept as printed.
